query:
update feeds
         set last_checked_at = $2,
             last_success_at = $2,
             next_check_at = $3,
             failure_count = 0,
             rate_limited_until = null,
             last_error = null,
             disabled_at = null,
             etag = coalesce($4, feeds.etag),
             last_modified = coalesce($5, feeds.last_modified),
             title = coalesce($6, feeds.title),
             site_url = coalesce($7, feeds.site_url)
         where id = $1
